name: Greene County, NY
findings: Greene County has 175 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Greene County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
